title: Billy Meier's past as a Middle East intelligence operative
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Billy Meier's past as a Middle East intelligence operative, about pre-1970s at Tehran; Turkey; Switzerland, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He got the name Billy when he was working in Tehran. The guy was 007. He was a James Bond style super spy field intelligence operative.

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani says that a man named Billy Meier, a well-known figure in UFO circles, had an earlier life as a spy. Drawing on a source called Closer Encounters, Jorjani says that before the 1970s Meier worked in the field for intelligence services in places like Tehran and Turkey, picked up the name Billy in Tehran, and was a James Bond style operative. If true, it would put Meier's later UFO claims in a very different light.
